title: Creamy Crumble Bread
description: A delicious vegetarian bread dish topped with a crunchy crumble mixture and a creamy sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Slice the bread into 1-inch thick slices.
In a bowl, mix together the softened cream cheese and Greek yogurt.
Spread the creamy mixture evenly over each bread slice.
In another bowl, mix together the crumble and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the creamy sauce.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes.
